business_summary: Daiwa Office Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as DOI) was established as an investment corporation under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations by the founder (the former daVinci Select now, Daiwa Real Estate Asset Management (hereinafter referred to as the Asset Manager). DOI is an externally managed real estate fund, established as an investment corporation. The Asset Manager, as DOI's asset management company, is engaged in acquiring, managing, leasing, and renovating office properties. Daiwa Securities Group Inc. currently owns 100% of the shares of the Asset Manager. On October 18, 2005, DOI had raised approximately 49,498,710 thousand yen through an initial public offering of units. Those units were listed on the J-REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. DOI implemented a 2 for 1 split of its investment units with a record date of May 31, 2024 and an effective date of June 1, 2024. As of May 31, 2026, DOI had ownership or trust beneficiary interests in 58 office properties with approximately 365,092.05 m2 of rentable office space and had leased office space to 666 tenants engaged in a variety of businesses. The occupancy rate for the office properties was approximately 99.1%. Daiwa Office Investment Corporation was established on July 11, 2005 and incorporated in Ontario, Canada.
business_summary_ko: Daiwa Office Investment Corporation(이하 DOI)은 설립자(구 daVinci Select(현 다빈치 셀렉트), Daiwa Real Estate Asset Management(이하 자산운용사))에 의해 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률에 따른 투자법인으로 설립되었습니다. DOI는 투자법인으로 설립된 외부에서 관리하는 부동산 펀드입니다. 자산운용사는 DOI의 자산운용사로서 오피스 자산의 취득, 관리, 임대 및 개조 업무를 담당하고 있습니다. 현재 Daiwa Securities Group Inc.가 소유하고 있습니다. DOI는 2005년 10월 18일에 주식 공모를 통해 약 49,498,710천엔을 조달했습니다. 해당 유닛은 2024년 5월 31일에 투자 유닛을 2대 1로 분할하여 2024년 5월 현재로 상장되었습니다. 2026년 3월 31일, DOI는 약 365,092.05m2의 임대 가능한 사무실 공간을 갖춘 58개의 사무실 자산에 대한 소유권 또는 신탁 수혜권을 갖고 있으며 다양한 사업에 종사하는 666명의 임차인에게 사무실 공간을 임대했습니다.
